family: N15 reserve-backed stablecoin issuance and crypto buying capacity
hypothesis: An increase in issued dollar-token balances can supply purchasing capacity for BTC. Conversely issuance may respond to flight to safety or issuer inventories; expansion is not inherently bullish. Test one fixed long rule, no reversal if it fails.
distinctness: Liability issuance of payment/settlement tokens, distinct from native-chain transfer activity N12, miner capacity N14, price/volume patterns, leverage N11, funding carry N2 and option IV N13. Final economic distinctness must still be independently reviewed; any alternative stablecoin basket or threshold remains this same family.

source.scope: Use source parent tickers exactly, no sum of parent and chain-specific children. Historical chain membership/vintages are unproven; changes in coverage can resemble issuance. No claim that this equals all liquid stablecoin capital.
source.limits: One public GET, page_size=10000, maximum 2 MB. A partial/error response is preserved and stops. No replacement basket after performance.
source.catalog: Public catalog-all-v2 confirms daily community availability of both metrics since before2021; metadata only was viewed before this registration. Earlier obsolete catalog request returned400 unsupported assets and is preserved.

rule.condition: SplyCur(usdt,D)+SplyCur(usdc,D) strictly exceeds the sum at D-7days. Require eight consecutive complete days for both. Each current PriceUSD must be within [0.99,1.01] inclusive. Supply sums are nominal token units at intended one-dollar parity, not realized USD balances.
rule.featureEnd: D+24h, treating source date D as day start
rule.positions: At most one; ignore new triggers while held; no reentry in exit hour.
rule.missing: Any missing, duplicate or nonpositive/nonfinite supply/price invalidates source; no interpolation.
rule.prospective: Each daily input requires exact source/vintage receipt between its day end and its own D+72h deadline. Historical publication times are assumed, never certified by the delay.

execution: Existing USD-M v4 fees/slippage base and stress, archived funding and conservative marks; BTC DEV2022-2024 only. Not certified The5ers execution.
selection: Freeze protocol, source hashes, code and tests before real trigger counts/PnL. At least100 raw triggers required before PnL; executed-trade minimum still applies. Failed DEV closes this configuration without2025/2026 evaluation, tuning, reversal or renamed variants.
